podcast.title: Imagine Dragons Catalog Acquisition (2020)
podcast.body: Concord Music Publishing acquired Imagine Dragons' music catalog for a reported $100 million in 2020. "In 2020, imagine Dragons sold their catalog to Concord Music Publishing for a reported, wait for it, $100 million."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Catalog Acquisition Company
podcast.body: Concord was mentioned as one of the companies involved in the "gold rush" for artists' music catalogs in the late 2010s. These companies, including Primary Wave and Hypnosis Song Fund, acquired music rights for long-term lucrative propositions, offering artists upfront financial security and tax advantages. "They had names like Primary Wave, Hypnosis Song Fund, Roundheal, Concord, and Half a Does Another's."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 100 Greatest Rock Moments of the Millennium So Far - Part 1: (100-91)

podcast.title: Music Catalog Acquisition Firm (mid-2010s)
podcast.body: One of a group of well-financed companies that have been actively buying up artists' music publishing rights since the mid-2010s, recognizing music as a valuable long-term investment. "There are companies like Primary Wave, Round Hill, Concord, and Hypnosis. They're all doing the same thing."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
